Feed Sales Intern - East Region Position Summary: 
As a Purina Feed Sales Intern, you will be employed by Land O'Lakes, Inc. and placed in a market with participating dealers and cooperatives. This is a field-based sales internship built for students who want to turn animal nutrition knowledge into real customer conversations, measurable market growth, and a stronger understanding of the dealer/co-op business model. You will work alongside local sales representatives, dealer/co-op leaders, and Purina team members to support customer engagement, territory growth, and species-specific nutrition solutions. 
 Interns will be provided with training through Purina Animal Nutrition, and the working location is dependent on those of our dealers. 
 Compensation: $22/hr
 Internship Duration: 
May – August 2027 (flexible start and end dates)
 Internship opportunities are available throughout the East Region. Potential locations may include Maine, Vermont, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Connecticut, New York, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Washington, D.C., Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, Florida. 
 Preferred species focus areas for this region include Beef and Equine candidates. Internship assignments will be based on business needs, market demand, candidate interests, and must have available dealer/cooperative partnerships within the region.
